name: 🇯🇵Jin's Vengeance⛩️
description: Did a six card swap to up the land count a bit and give more flexibility.  Also made the call to remove Rhystic Study; after a lot of games, found the deck doesn't need it and I was always wanting to cast other stuff.  Primer updated to include guidance on opening hands since I've gotten that question a lot. If you want to know why I'm not running random card X, it's because every slot is an insanely tough call.  There are tons of fun cards in the "Considering" section to check out if you want some ideas.  Riding a line between voltron and midrange usually doesn't work too great, but Jin ties it together and lets you do both pretty damn well. You can win out of nowhere with Hatred/Infect swings and have the resilience and protection to grind out longer games. I'm purposefully not running any infinite combos/hard stax/universal tutors in this list. "I am not your son.  I am the Ghost.". ⛩️🇯🇵
mainboard: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
King T'Challa // Black Panther, Hope Enduring
